en.title: Toggles and selection groups take the release policy
en.body: createToggleControl and createSelectionGroup take activation and tapTolerance, as createActionControl does. With activation 'releaseInside', a press dragged off a switch or an item and released there neither flips it nor selects it. capturedRelease stays the default.

zh.title: 开关和单选组支持松手位置策略
zh.body: createToggleControl 和 createSelectionGroup 与 createActionControl 一样支持 activation 和 tapTolerance。设为 'releaseInside' 时，按下后拖出开关或选项再松手，既不翻转也不选中。默认仍是 capturedRelease。
